intro: Down the Rabbit Hole AUST offers the rubbish removal Canberra homeowners, tenants and landlords use for the small, awkward loads that never quite make it to the tip. Old pots and broken planters, rotten timber and fence palings, a rusted outdoor setting, the leftovers from a garage clean-out or the last trailer load at the end of a lease. We load it from wherever it sits on your property and take it away the same day.

We are fully insured, ABN registered and locally operated, Est. 2021. Down the Rabbit Hole AUST is owned and run by Michael Robinson, so you deal directly with the owner. Quotes for rubbish removal Canberra wide are free and given upfront, based on a photo of what needs to go.

sections.h2: What we take and what we do not
paras: We handle small-scale loads, the kind that fit in a trailer or ute rather than a skip truck. Most of the rubbish removal Canberra gardens call for is pots, timber and broken furniture, but general household junk from a clean-out is fine too.

There are things we do not take. We are not licensed for asbestos or anything suspected to contain it, so old fibro sheeting is out. We do not take chemicals, paint, fuel, gas bottles or car batteries, and we do not handle commercial demolition or building waste. If your load includes any of those, we will say so upfront and point you to the right disposal option.
bullets: Garden and yard rubbish: pots, planters, broken edging, old trellis and stakes
Timber offcuts, pallets, fence palings and rotten decking boards
Broken outdoor furniture, umbrellas, barbecues and play equipment
General household junk from a clean-out: boxes, shelving, small furniture
End of lease loads, mixed with green waste if needed

paras: Send a photo of the pile and your suburb, and tell us whether there is anything heavy or awkward, such as a concrete pot or a steel frame. We quote upfront. Rubbish removal Canberra wide is priced on the volume and the type of material, because mixed waste and clean green waste are sorted differently at the resource management centres.

On the day we load from wherever the rubbish is, whether that is the back corner of the yard, a carport or the side of the house. We sweep the spot and leave. You do not need to move anything to the kerb, and nothing is left on the nature strip.

sections.h2: End of lease and clean-out loads around Canberra
paras: Canberra has a lot of rentals and a lot of moving. An end of lease in Kaleen or Wanniassa often finishes with a pile of things the tenant cannot fit in the car and the landlord does not want, sitting under the carport. Sellers in Narrabundah or Greenway clearing a family home before an open house run into the same thing, decades of pots and timber behind the shed.

Autumn and spring are when most people tackle the yard, and a rubbish removal Canberra pick-up often gets booked alongside a green waste collection or a full yard clean-up, so the property is cleared in one visit. We collect across Canberra and in Queanbeyan, from Macgregor to Wanniassa.

faqs.q: What can I not put in a rubbish removal load?
faqs.a: Asbestos or anything that might contain it, chemicals, paint, fuel, gas bottles, batteries, and commercial demolition or building waste. We are a small-scale service and are not set up or licensed for those. Tell us what is in the pile and we will be straight with you about what we can take.

faqs.q: Do you do rubbish removal Canberra wide or only some suburbs?
faqs.a: We cover most Canberra districts, including Weston Creek, Woden Valley, Belconnen, Tuggeranong and the Inner South, plus Queanbeyan, Jerrabomberra and Googong in NSW. Suburbs we cover include Kaleen, Macgregor, Wanniassa, Greenway and Narrabundah. If your suburb is not listed, ask.

faqs.q: Can you take garden rubbish and green waste in the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes. Rubbish removal Canberra jobs can be a mixed load at the end of a yard clean-up, with old pots and timber in one part of the trailer and clippings in the other, because they are disposed of separately. Tell us what is in the pile and we will quote both together in one figure.

faqs.q: Do I need to bring everything to the front of the house?
faqs.a: No. Rubbish removal Canberra wide means we load from wherever it is, including back yards, sheds and carports, as long as we can get through. If access is tight or something is very heavy, mention it when you send the photo so we bring the right gear to move it safely.

faqs.q: How do you work out the price?
faqs.a: On volume and type of material, from a photo. Every load is different, so we quote each one and confirm before we start. The upfront quote covers loading, transport and disposal. That is how every rubbish removal Canberra job we do is priced.
